original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.

actual_scope: Characterize clean invariant encodings E satisfying i^u C_d E = E (I_(2^s) tensor C_n), for integers n,s >= 1 and u in {0,1,2,3}: exact eigenspace domination, explicit dyadic Walsh intertwiners and decoders, least ambient width n+s+1 or n+s+2, and the full ambient-volume charge under the inherited tariff. Corroborate n,s=1..64 and small literal operator fixtures. This is an algebraic clean-complement contract and a negative tariff screen, without physical supplier admission. The least d is for literal C_d without a separately variable spectator factor; common spectator extension is E tensor I with the same factor. Arbitrary spectator reassignment is outside that minimum-width and cost formula. Give the sharp closed residue classification: fixed phase n>=3 always uses one extra axis; at n=1 selector residues0,6,7 pass with one extra, at n=2 residues0,1,5,6,7 do; other fixed small cases require two. Optional fourth-root phase always needs exactly one extra axis.
scope_change_reason: Fresh overlap found Arham's active Discussion #1901 claiming the full-space conjugation obstruction and opposite-direction exception. The selected physical block-climb construction card is therefore changed before implementation to the distinct clean invariant-subspace contract; the full-space endpoint is credited prior art, and this package does not satisfy the card's 5% constructive acceptance gate.
bottleneck_link: Combining independently paid lanes into a larger-rank child requires the native tensor operator to preserve an encoded lane subspace. This gives an exact algebraic admission criterion and charges its compulsory extra ambient volume; even with encoder and restoration costs waived, the inherited child-budget expression exceeds the separate-lane expression by more than a factor of two.
stop_rule: Stop construction at 14:18:32 UTC and use the final quarter for exact receipt replay, independent review, source and metadata checks, and handoff. Restrict synthesis to explicit small Walsh fixtures and the stated n,s=1..64 corroboration; do not build Lean, run cold suppliers, or change the selected frontier.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the sharp all-size single-host clean-encoding width and inherited volume tariff comparison. CERTIFICATE.json records 4096 width cases, 131 independent multiplicity counts, 12 complete literal butterfly/Gram fixtures and seven semantic/domain controls. Registered Python3.12.14 replay passes; five no-Git optimized/source/receipt/output tests pass. These are scoped algebraic and budget results, not physical supplier admission or the card construction gate. The closed all-size residue formula is separately corroborated in all4096 finite width cases.
